subject: english
question:
The sentence has been divided into three parts, identify the error segment in the sentence given below. Choose no error if there is no error in the sentence.

Her latest novel is considered one of the most captivating story / in contemporary literature, earning praise / for its intricate plot and well - developed characters.

options.text: Her latest novel is considered one of the most captivating story
for its intricate plot and well-developed characters.

solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the first part of the given sentence, the singular form of the noun 'story' is incorrect.
 
• The correct form should be 'stories' to match the plural context set by **'one of the most captivating'**.
 
• Therefore, the plural form 'stories' should be used instead of the singular form 'story'.

Hence, the correct sentence is** "*Her latest novel is considered one of the most captivating stories __in contemporary literature, earning praise for its intricate plot and well-developed characters*."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• When referring to one item from a group of items, the noun following **'one of the'** should be **plural**.

 
 
• **Example:** *She is one of the best **teachers** in the school*.
